title: Account

music.label: Music
music.description: Background music while you browse and pull.

danger.heading: Danger zone
danger.deleteBody: Permanently deletes your account, wallet balance, and card collection.
danger.confirmBody: This will permanently remove your account and all associated data, including your card collection and wallet balance. This action cannot be undone.
danger.deleteError: Something went wrong while deleting your account. Please try again.

privacyNote: Tokyo Lucky Card processes your personal data in accordance with the Thai Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA). You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time.

addresses.label: Delivery addresses
addresses.description: Where your physical cards are shipped.

security.heading: Sign-in & security
security.name: Name
security.changeEmailBody: We will send a confirmation link to the new address. Your current address keeps working until you click it.
security.changeEmailSent: Confirmation sent to {{email}}. Your email changes once you click the link in it.
security.pendingBody: We are waiting for {{email}} to be confirmed. Until then your account stays on {{current}}.
security.needPasswordFirst: This account signs in with Google. Set a password first — we ask for it to confirm a change of email, so that a forgotten open browser cannot be used to take the account.
security.changePasswordBody: You will be signed out everywhere, including on this device.
security.setPasswordBody: Adds email and password as a second way to sign in. Your Google sign-in keeps working.
security.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
